notes.subject: האח נפשנו
notes.rationale: 'Aha, our nepeš' is a gloat; rendered 'aha, an ka nyini tiɲɛna' (aha, our desire is fulfilled) after the versions

notes.subject: nyini
notes.rationale: נפש here is appetite/desire, not 'soul'; Bambara nyini (desire) keeps the shape

notes.subject: tiɲɛna
notes.rationale: supplied 'is fulfilled' to make the gloat a complete sentence

notes.subject: בלענוהו
notes.rationale: 'we swallowed him' vs 'we devoured him'; literal swallowing kept with suffix -hu as object ⟨a⟩

translation: K'u kana fɔ u dusukun na: “Aha, an ka nyini tiɲɛna!” K'u kana fɔ: “An ye ⟨a⟩ minɛ ka a dun.”

tokens.gloss: an ye ⟨a⟩ minɛ ka a dun
